claim.quote: New precise results of a measurement of the elastic electron-proton scattering cross section performed at the Mainz Microtron MAMI are presented.

name: A1 high-precision determination of the electric and magnetic form factors of the proton

summary.plain: A1 measured about 1400 elastic electron-proton scattering cross sections at Mainz with errors below 0.2%, and extracted the proton's electric and magnetic form factors, which show features at the scale of the pion cloud and give the proton radius.
summary.technical: About 1400 elastic e-p cross sections measured with the three A1 spectrometers for Q^2 up to 1 (GeV/c)^2 with statistical errors below 0.2%; electric and magnetic form factors extracted by direct fits of form-factor models to the cross sections, showing features at the pion-cloud scale.

title: High-precision determination of the electric and magnetic form factors of the proton
why_it_matters: The result feeds the proton charge radius determination and the proton radius puzzle, and tests the pion-cloud description of the nucleon.
